tan_to_no2_rate.source: Sensitivity assumption: +/-50% around the placeholder hourly TAN nitrification rate in engine.py; not a measured confidence interval.

no2_to_no3_rate.source: Sensitivity assumption: +/-50% around the placeholder hourly nitrite nitrification rate in engine.py; not a measured confidence interval.

shelter_factor.source: Sensitivity assumption around the telemetry-calibrated 0.6 shelter factor documented in evaporation_engine.py; no fitted error distribution is available.

depth_m.source: Typical koi pond depth range already documented in evaporation_engine.py. Applied only when depth is assumed, never to a measured profile or explicit query depth.

fallback_intrinsic_rate.source: Sensitivity assumption: +/-50% around FALLBACK_INTRINSIC_RATE in algae_engine.py (per day). Applied only to literature_fallback, not a camera-fitted rate.
